provenance.by: the bench agent (an AI agent working on the owner's machine), not a person and not this repository's code
provenance.source: the ranging dashboard running on the owner's Arduino UNO Q, endpoint /api/state (its summary over the last 50 ranges), read on 2026-11-15 between about 05:50 and 06:30 UTC
provenance.transcribed_into_repo: 2026-11-15 by the lead of this module, copied unchanged from the bench agent's notes (hardware/twr_firmware/README.md, 'Measured')
caveats: The spacings '~0.24 m' and '~1.57 m' are the bench notes' descriptions; no independent tape-measure value was recorded, so the absolute accuracy (the constant bias) of these ranges is UNKNOWN.
Antenna delays were the uncalibrated default 16385 (TX and RX): every distance carries an unknown constant offset.
Two boards, one bench, one evening, line of sight, short range. Nothing here says anything about range through walls, at 10 m, or between boards on the floor.
The dashboard's RX-level number uses the generic formula constant -121.7 dB, not a per-board calibration.

runs.cumulative_success_note: derived: 100 x ok / (ok + timeouts), computed by hand from the two counts above

failures_seen_while_tuning: Responder turnaround 1100 us is shorter than the poll's air time (about 1.3 ms at 850 kbps with a 1024-symbol preamble): every reply was late (late_tx climbed) and the initiator saw 100% timeouts. Fixed at 2700 us.
Without dwt_configciadiag(DW_CIA_DIAG_LOG_ALL) the receive diagnostic registers read 0 (no RX level, no preamble count).
